notes: Independently decoded NSO offsets 0x1c53fb7, 0x1cd4f52, 0x1c9b3ab and 0x1d3db7d to DATA_CC_CURRENT, texture_name, sub_category_name and quantity. The two little-endian comparisons match Icons and Banners. Each helper copies the supplied name to two objects in the customization context before a trailing update call. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration.

Independently decoded Inc_Tokens and all three token event labels at offsets 0x1ce6390, 0x1cf26e1, 0x1c4a21d and 0x1c866e9. Input x0 is kept in x19. LD32/ST32 at +0x9c feed single-precision arithmetic and comparisons. LD16/ST16 at +0xa0 are zero-extended and tested under unsigned conditions, with an increment and a later assignment from the limit. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration.

Decoded output title, item keys and option strings directly from the NSO at their lifted addresses. DATA_C_CURRENT is the source, with quantity, is_collectable and id reads. Quantity controls whether the lock/unlock entry is included and is_collectable selects one of the two labels. Writes option records and returns 3 or 4 on this path. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration.

Independently decoded both value keys and the prompt/options from the NSO, including prompt offset 0x1c6eecc. The first 32-bit lookup is id, which is copied to context +0x1b4 only after the can_discard result equals 1. Output slots contain Yes and No. The separate 0x7000c58710 body has the same operation. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration.

Independently decoded DATA_M_CURRENT, id, can_discard and both prompt option labels. Matches the behavior of 0x7000c384ac including the 32-bit context +0x1b4 update and gated prompt assembly. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration.

The decoded DATA_EQ_CURRENT, DATA_EQ, item and id operands match the proposal. Index range validation and selected-entry publication precede resource helper branches, whose final purpose remains unresolved. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration.

Decoded all four named keys from NSO. The ST8 at receiver +0x11 records equality against the context +0x1a0 qword, while the other branch sign-extends the player_id output into nested object +0x40. Registration recovered in f_7000932f94, which allocates a 0x20-byte wrapper, stores this address at wrapper +0x10, and installs the wrapper at owner +0x18. The specific event that invokes this callback remains unresolved.

Decoded DraftRoundsScroller and FantasyDraftRoundsScroller at NSO offsets 0x1ccc12d and 0x1d2b921. The function saves entry x0 in x19, uses LD32 and ST32 at +0x2a64, branches on the signed decrement result and resets the countdown to 10 on the expiration path. The reset occurs even if the target lookup fails. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration.

Decoded all format/variant strings from the NSO, including the combined format at offset 0x1cc7a5c. The generated code supplies the three selected parts and passes destination base +0xc0 and count 0xff to the copy helper. It follows with an explicit ST8 zero at base +0x1bf. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration.

Decoded percent-d, team_ids and raid_team_id from the NSO; body confirms the two writes and the follow-on object installation/forwarding. Registration recovered in f_700091aee8, which allocates a 0x20-byte wrapper, stores this address at wrapper +0x10, and installs it at owner +0x18. The specific event that invokes this callback remains unresolved.
